sprint: Sprint 10: Convergence Intelligence and Adaptive Constraint Governance
lane: LANE 4 — Jpeg/Tiff Extension Constraint Fix + Image Wave Pilot

constraint_fix_summary.problem: Jpeg and Tiff output extension constraints were not enforced by the validator. LLM generated output.pdf (wrong) for Jpeg and output.tif (3 letters, wrong) for Tiff. These were deterministic failures confirmed across Sprint 9 runs.
constraint_fix_summary.root_cause: The _validate_code_from_constraints() function in code_generator.py only handled two pattern types: (1) 'using' directives and (2) method/constructor calls (text before first '('). Patterns without '(' fell through silently — meaning REQUIRED: "output.jpg" added no validation check.

fix_applied.change: Added literal-string branch to _validate_code_from_constraints(): patterns without '(' and len >= 4 are now checked as verbatim substrings in generated code.
pdf_yml_additions: REQUIRED: "output.jpg" — JPEG output filename MUST be output.jpg (not output.pdf, not output.jpeg). The Jpeg plugin writes a .jpg file, never a .pdf.
REQUIRED: "output.tiff" — TIFF output filename MUST be output.tiff (four letters, not output.tif). The Tiff plugin writes a .tiff file.

constraint_fix_summary.validator_status: WORKING — literal-string constraint correctly rejects code with wrong output filenames

Merger.notes: Stable — passes consistently across Sprint 10 runs.

Optimizer.notes: Passes in Sprint 10. Needs 2nd consecutive reviewer pass for live PR.

PdfAConverter.notes: Wave A type. Passes consistently after REQUIRED: new PdfAConvertOptions( constraint was added.

Jpeg.failure_reason: Post-repair validation failed: REQUIRED: "output.jpg" — JPEG output filename MUST be output.jpg. LLM generated output.pdf even after repair prompt.
Jpeg.constraint_was_effective: Correctly rejected wrong code — but LLM cannot converge on correct filename from repair prompt alone.
Jpeg.next_action: Add few-shot example to llm-fewshot-patterns.json showing correct Jpeg output filename. Expected convergence confidence improvement: 0.55 -> 0.85+.

Tiff.failure_reason: Post-repair validation failed: REQUIRED: "output.tiff" — TIFF output filename MUST be output.tiff (four letters, not output.tif). LLM generated output.tif even after repair.
Tiff.constraint_was_effective: Correctly rejected wrong code — but LLM cannot converge on correct filename from repair prompt alone.
Tiff.next_action: Add few-shot example to llm-fewshot-patterns.json showing correct Tiff output filename. Expected convergence confidence improvement: 0.55 -> 0.85+.

Png.failure_reason: Unhandled exception. System.IO.FileNotFoundException: Output file was not created. File name: 'output.png'
Png.root_cause: The Png plugin (PdfToImage) creates page-numbered output files (e.g., output_0.png) rather than a single output.png. The generated example checks File.Exists("output.png") which fails.
Png.next_action: Update Png constraint to expect result.ResultCollection.Count > 0 rather than File.Exists("output.png"). Add REQUIRED: result.ResultCollection constraint for image types.
